bootstrap.method: Efron-Tibshirani 1993 paired percentile bootstrap, stratified by DoE iteration

claim_scope: Prospective-transfer validity attestation for the Guth-Gold scratch-hardness design-rule baseline on Purformance HTE 2K-PUR lacquer only, normalized feature domain [0,1]^4, 3 sequential BO iterations. Quantifies but does not correct covariate shift. Grants no batch-release, qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority. Intervals are marginal not conditional. Phase-1 would require independent wet-lab validation on a NEW prospective iteration and a cross-formulator dataset.
convex_hull_membership_test: exact LP feasibility (lambda>=0, sum lambda=1, X_train^T lambda = x_test), scipy.optimize.linprog method=highs, deterministic
fold_coincidence_note: The train{1,2}->test{3} fold is identical under both schemes; the paired optimism contrast is therefore driven entirely by the iteration-2 fold (train{1,3} vs train{1}). Stated for honesty; the pairing is exact and the bootstrap is over identical test points.
honest_interpretation: Forward-chained (prospective) evaluation of the receipted Guth-Gold design-rule baseline on the Purformance HTE 2K-PUR sequential-BO DoE, on the identical prospective test region (iterations 2+3, n=69) as a paired LOIO evaluation. Covariate shift between BO rounds is real: max |Cohen's d| per forward fold is 0.089 (train 1 -> test 2) and 0.181 (train 1+2 -> test 3), and 81% / 14% of prospective test formulations fall OUTSIDE the training convex hull, i.e. true extrapolation. Prospective pooled R2: Guth-Gold 0.1917 (LOIO-restricted 0.2893), linear-4 0.2283, constant -0.0114. The paired LOIO-minus-forward optimism Delta-R2 for Guth-Gold is 0.0976 with 95% CI [-0.0479, 0.3083], which INCLUDES zero -- LOIO is NOT demonstrably materially optimistic for this module's prospective decision task (any optimism is driven entirely by the iteration-2 fold, since the iteration-3 fold coincides under both schemes). Prospectively, Guth-Gold minus linear-4 Delta-R2 = -0.0365, CI [-0.0993, 0.0139] (INCLUDES zero): the mechanistic law is statistically indistinguishable from the flexible linear form under BO-induced extrapolation. The hostile-null label shuffle collapses forward Guth-Gold R2 to -0.0754 (<0.10 gate PASS), confirming the prospective signal is not an artifact of the evaluation plumbing.
parent_receipt_notes: Extends benchmarks/guth-gold-physical-baseline-v1 (pooled LOIO R2=0.3345), benchmarks/directional-concordance-v1 and benchmarks/alt-reinforcement-law-v1, all of which evaluate LOIO only. The iteration-2 LOIO fold conditions on future iteration-3 data that would not exist at decision time; no prior receipt evaluates the prospective (deployment-order) setting the mission's decision unit actually requires.
sequential_design_provenance: Iterations are sequential Bayesian-optimization rounds (Cordts et al. 2024): each round's design region is proposed by an optimizer conditioned on all earlier rounds, inducing covariate shift between train and prospective test.
shared_model_structure: H = H0*(1 + a*Vernetzung + b*HDI_IPDI)*R_GG(phi); phi = cm*Mattierungsmittel + cp*Pigmentpaste; R_GG = 1 + 2.5*phi + 14.1*phi^2; least_squares TRF, bounded, identical init/bounds to parent receipts; deterministic.
split_forward: forward-chained: train{1}->test{2} (n=17->27), train{1,2}->test{3} (n=44->42); Bergmeir-Benitez 2012 / Sheridan 2013 time-split
split_loio_restricted: LOIO folds restricted to the same test region: train{1,3}->test{2}, train{1,2}->test{3}
